idea: a spooky lighthouse where a tiny keeper relights lamps to calm the ghosts
creator: Ahmed
title: Hushlight Keeper

design.title: Hushlight Keeper
design.tagline: Hum soft, relight the lamps, and hush the lonely ghosts to sleep.
design.story: The lighthouse went cold and its lonely ghosts grew chilly and restless. Tiny keeper Pip climbs the dark stairs with cocoa, lantern, and moth buddy Miff, humming soft notes to rewarm each lamp and tuck the ghosts back to sleep to relight the beacon.

hero.name: Pip the Keeper
hero.look: tiny round keeper in oversized mustard-yellow raincoat with teal patches, hood up, rosy cheeks and sleepy kind eyes, holding a small brass lantern, seen from above in soft chibi style

world.setting: a small spooky lighthouse at night with creaky lamp rooms above and a quiet glowing tide-pool basement below, wrapped in fog
world.mood: gentle spooky, hushed, warm and cozy

specialMechanic.name: Humming Warm-Up
specialMechanic.howItWorks: Hold X near a cold lamp to hum a soft note. A warm ring grows, lights the lamp as a safe checkpoint, and gently shoos nearby ghosts away.

levels.name: Stairlight Halls
levels.idea: Explore creaky lamp rooms, hum cold lamps warm to light them as checkpoints, find brass key and shoo pouty ghosts to the beacon door.

levels.name: Tidepool Basement
levels.idea: tiptoe through quiet basement tide-pools, light shell path and warm final lamp to calm the big fog ghost and relight beacon.

sprites.name: hero
sprites.prompt: tiny round child in oversized mustard-yellow raincoat with teal patches and hood up, rosy cheeks, sleepy kind eyes, holding small glowing brass lantern, top-down view, soft cozy colors

sprites.name: enemy
sprites.prompt: small pouty drifting sheet-ghost, pale blue-white translucent rounded sheet, sleepy grumpy eyes, rosy cheeks, soft wispy tail, gentle cute style

sprites.name: enemy2
sprites.prompt: large slow sleepy fog blob ghost, soft lavender-gray misty round body, droopy closed eyes, tiny frown, faint blue glow inside

sprites.name: collectible
sprites.prompt: small pastel spiral seashell with soft mint and peach stripes, glowing warm golden core, dewy shine, cute rounded shape

sprites.name: powerup
sprites.prompt: tiny chubby brass mug of cocoa with steam swirl shaped like music note, warm caramel color, cozy glow

sprites.name: goal
sprites.prompt: round brass lighthouse lens door with glowing warm golden glass panes and heart-shaped handle, cozy beacon light

sprites.name: tile
sprites.prompt: dark slate-blue lighthouse wall block seen from above, brass rivet edge, faint salt speckles, sturdy rounded stone

sprites.name: floor
sprites.prompt: dark wooden plank floor texture seen from above, faded teal spiral pattern, salt speckles and soft puddle shine

sprites.name: background
sprites.prompt: wide scenic view of cozy spooky lighthouse on rocky cliff at night under fog, warm lit windows, dark sea and glowing tide-pools below, no characters

sprites.name: lamp
sprites.prompt: small brass lighthouse lamp post with frosty pale-blue round glass globe, snowflake frost pattern, tiny unlit wick inside

verdict.summary: Explore dark halls with your lantern, collect shells, hum to shoo ghosts and find the key - movement, collecting, humming and damage all work.
verdict.seen: Screenshots show dark tiled halls lit by the yellow-coated hero's lantern, with glowing shells, lamps, ghosts, and readable star, heart and hint HUD.

seasons.notes: Built Hushlight Keeper as dark top-down with glow humming, 2 enclosed lamp levels, keys/doors, shells, cocoa light power, and moth-buddy flavor text.
